{{Tabs|History = No}} {{For|other uses of [[Elf (Disambiguation)|Elf]]}} {{UnitInfobox |title1 = Guardian Elf |image-static = GuardianElfDec25.png |image-dynamic = GuardianElfDynamic.png |image-dynamic-start = 22 |pseudoxd = true |source = [[Elf Camp]] |level = 2 |type = Humanoid |spawnrate = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]10s |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]50 |defense = {{Defense}}30% |damage_type = Collision
Single |ranged_damage = [[File:OffensiveModifier.png|20px|Damage]]18 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.5 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]7 |speed = 8 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Level 0+}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Level 0+}} (Collision only) |flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Guardian Elf''', internally referred to as the '''Warrior Elf''', is one of the units that spawns from the [[Elf Camp]]. It spawns when the [[Elf Camp]] is at Levels 3-4, replacing the [[Elf]]. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. It has a spawnrate of 10 seconds. Whenever there is an enemy in its range, the '''Guardian Elf''' will stop moving and attack the enemy. It will continue walking when there are no enemies left in its range. There's a limit of 30 '''Guardian Elves''' per [[Elf Camp]]. ==Appearance== The '''Guardian Elf''' features light skin, blonde hair, and a serious, downturned expression with distinct light blue freckle clusters under each eye. Its outfit consists of a green tunic with a red bandana and red outline at the end of a sleeve, and a brown belt with a gold buckle. It wears a tall green shako hat decorated with a gold star, a black under outline, and red accents along the top. It wears dark pants tucked into pointed brown boots that feature white socks. Wields a silver-bladed sword with a red grip and orange guard. ==Statistics== {{neow| $DPS$ = Damage / Firerate $RAM$ = Health / Spawnrate

}} ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:GuardianElf.png|175px]] |[[File:ChocolatierGuardianElf.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Christmas2025|Classic}} |{{Color|Valentines2026|Chocolatier}} |- !Obtained From |[[Christmas 2025 Crate]] |[[Valentines 2026 Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Guardian Elf''' is can be quite useful against slower enemies, such as the [[Molten]], [[Slow Boss]] or [[Fallen Giant]]. **However, due to its low range, it will struggle against faster enemies with high health, like the [[Fallen]], [[Bolt]] or [[Molten Necromancer]]. *On two-pathed maps, only one '''Guardian Elf''' will spawn per Level 3-4 [[Elf Camp]]. It will go down a random path. *The '''Guardian Elf''' can be useful against [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies with low health, like the [[Hidden]]s and [[Fallen Soul]]s, though it will struggle against hidden enemies with higher health, like the [[Hidden Boss]]. **The '''Guardian Elf''' cannot collide with [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] enemies like [[Soul]]s. *The '''Guardian Elf''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Heavy]] or [[Elite Abnormal]]. **Do note that its melee attack is affected by defense. *The '''Guardian Elf''' is not affected by any buff or debuff. *The '''Guardian Elf''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units because of its low health. **For example, if the [[Fallen King]] uses its ''Sword Swing'' attack, and a '''Guardian Elf''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly defeated. ==Trivia== *The {{Color|Christmas2025|Classic}} skin is based on the [[Cookie Guard (Cold Ambush)|Cookie Guard]] enemy from [[Cold Ambush]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''21 December 2022''' -
